headline: 2 injured as double-decker bus hits pillar of Elevated Expressway
summary: The accident occurred when a bus crashed into a support pillar of the expressway, leaving two people injured.
details: A double-decker bus crashed into a support pillar of the Elevated Expressway, resulting in injuries to two people.
The collision occurred at night, causing significant damage to the vehicle and debris to scatter across the road.
Emergency services and local authorities were alerted to the scene to manage the traffic and provide assistance to the injured.
The cause of the accident has not yet been officially confirmed, and investigations are ongoing to determine how the collision happened.
